title: XAMS Overview
description: Temperatures, pressures, flow and high voltage. Provisioned from git — see DESIGN.md §12. No threshold lines: thresholds live in alarms.yaml and drawing them here would duplicate the number (§11).

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, channel AS metric, value FROM meas WHERE channel LIKE 'tt2%' AND quality = 'ok' AND $__timeFilter(t) ORDER BY t
SELECT t AS time, channel AS metric, value FROM meas WHERE (channel LIKE 'tt1%' OR channel LIKE 'tt3%' OR channel = 'ttamb') AND quality = 'ok' AND $__timeFilter(t) ORDER BY t

panels.title: Pressures
panels.description: Units are TBD (§16) and must not be guessed — the axis is deliberately unlabelled until the transducer datasheets are checked.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, channel AS metric, value FROM meas WHERE channel IN ('pmain','p101','p102','p103','p104') AND quality = 'ok' AND $__timeFilter(t) ORDER BY t

panels.title: Flow (fm101) — mass flow, g/min
panels.description: NOT SLPM. The LabVIEW front panel label is wrong (§4.2).

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, channel AS metric, value FROM meas WHERE channel = 'fm101' AND quality = 'ok' AND $__timeFilter(t) ORDER BY t

panels.title: High voltage — VMON (signed)
panels.description: Values are stored signed: cathode, gate, both screens and both PMTs are negative; anode and NaI positive (§7.2).

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, channel AS metric, value FROM meas WHERE channel LIKE 'hv_%_vmon' AND quality = 'ok' AND $__timeFilter(t) ORDER BY t
SELECT t AS time, channel AS metric, value FROM meas WHERE channel LIKE 'hv_%_imon' AND quality = 'ok' AND $__timeFilter(t) ORDER BY t

panels.title: Channels not reading OK
panels.description: Anything stale, errored or unverified. Empty is the healthy state — a frozen plausible value is worse than a gap (principle 4).

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (channel) channel, t, quality, value, unit FROM meas WHERE quality <> 'ok' AND $__timeFilter(t) ORDER BY channel, t DESC
